text: Artificial intelligence, or AI, is a field of computer science that creates machines able to perform tasks that normally require human intelligence, such as learning, problem-solving, and understanding language. Machine learning is a key part of AI: instead of following fixed rules, computers learn from data and improve over time. Deep learning, which uses artificial neural networks, takes this further and powers many modern systems. Today, AI is part of our daily lives. It helps us find information online, suggests films and music, translates languages, and even assists doctors in making diagnoses. AI is not science fiction — it is already all around us.
